<summary>Text description of this diagram</summary>

Three boxes joined left to right, and between them the whole of the short path.

1. **Agree the question**, in [Phase 1](/guidance/01-engagement-and-scoping/index.qmd). With your
   commissioner: the decision it informs, the question in one sentence, and the deadline.
2. **Decide your assurance level**, also in Phase 1. Score six impact and six likelihood
   dimensions, take the highest of each, and read the level off the matrix. About five minutes.
   See [deciding your assurance level](/guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd).
3. **Do what that level requires**, across [Phase 2](/guidance/02-design/index.qmd),
   [Phase 3](/guidance/03-analysis/index.qmd) and
   [Phase 4](/guidance/04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd). Read the column for your level. The
   levels are cumulative, so yours does everything the levels below it do and adds its own.

A panel below reads: and that is most work. Everything else here answers a question these
three raise.

</details>
